# lmw messages show

Show the latest messages of a conversation

### Synopsis

Show the latest messages of a conversation, oldest first. This does not mark it as read.

```
lmw messages show CONVERSATION [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help        help for show
  -n, --limit int   number of messages (1-50) (default 20)
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --json      print JSON output
  -v, --verbose   show debug logs, including every API request
```
